hypothesis: A small number of deterministic temporal prototypes selected from the frozen source's actual positive-product affinity may provide a structured readout that avoids the fixed-slot global-color collapse observed in SW0123.
scope: Stage 1 evaluation only. No training, decoder, GT-selected input, or checkpoint modification.

source.checkpoint: same-seed complete SW0097 positive_frozen whole core
source.note: Core state is strictly loaded unchanged; only object-group discovery output is discarded as in the registered evaluator. No learned encoder or changed dynamics.

inputs.gamma: registered SW0042 validation cache [320,8,256], IDs1320-1639, frozen encoder/preprocessing manifest and SHA validated
inputs.actual_traces: source core last_component_spikes [B,4,256,1024], production component order
inputs.centering: subtract each component/patch trace temporal mean over settle frames 512:1024
inputs.scaling: divide by same-seed SW0123 passed frozen legacy actual-spike TRAIN RMS4; bind the original calibration record and its spike_rms SHA

readout.anchor_affinity: detached registered production positive product of four actual component spike Pearson correlations on frames512:1024
readout.first_anchor: lowest patch index attaining maximum Q row sum
readout.later_anchors: among unselected patches whose centered/scaled actual trace is not exactly identical to any selected anchor trace, choose the lowest index attaining minimum maximum-Q to selected anchors; stop if that minimum maximum-Q is >=0.50
readout.duplicate_rule: exact trace equality only; no novelty epsilon. If no distinct trace remains, stop (including a flat K=1 case).
readout.prototype_initialization: gather live centered/scaled actual traces at selected detached anchor indices
readout.refinement: 3 updates: scores=-mean_D,T((X-U)^2); P=softmax(scores/0.1); U=P^T X / max(slot_mass,1). Then recompute final P from the updated U.
readout.unused_slots: zero probability columns after actual K prototypes
readout.primary_labels: unchanged SW0123 assignment_to_labels: argmax; largest occupied slot background, tie by first occupied patch; foreground slot below2 patches becomes background
readout.secondary_baseline: unchanged actual four-component production QCC: Q>=0.50, min2, largest connected component background; reported separately

evaluation.ground_truth_access: Only after all three-seed prototype and production-QCC predictions are saved and SHA-verified; source production-QCC scores must reproduce immutable SW0097 per-image metrics before any prototype result is scored or gate is reported.

promotion_gates.paired_bootstrap: 10000 draws, seed124, shared sampled image indices across all three source-seed reports; 95% lower bound strictly positive for prototype-minus-source FG-ARI
promotion_gates.failure: Close stage without changing threshold, affinity, initialization, prototype count, iterations, or seed set.

limitations: This tests only a frozen source readout and does not demonstrate a learned-model improvement.
The detached affinity controls anchor selection; live gradients through final prototype probabilities are not a training result.
K=1 and all-background outcomes are valid outputs and are not repaired by adding prototypes from GT or coordinates.
